background_steps.name: the MCAD Software is in the part modeling workspace
no command or modal dialog is active

scenario_steps.name: a visible 3D sketch curve has an exposed endpoint
the user clicks the endpoint
the pick cue identifies "1. Point (3D Sketch1)"
a compact contextual toolbar appears beside the pointer

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software is in the part modeling workspace
no command or modal dialog is active

scenario_steps.name: a visible 3D sketch curve is not selected
the user clicks a span of the curve
the curve appears bright green
a compact contextual toolbar appears beside the pointer

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software is in the part modeling workspace
no command or modal dialog is active

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with an unselected front face
the user clicks an unoccupied region of the face
the face appears teal with a bright green boundary
the pick cue identifies "1. Face"
a compact contextual toolbar appears beside the pointer

scenarios.name: Open the context menus for a selected solid face

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software is in the part modeling workspace
no command or modal dialog is active

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with a solid face selected
the user right-clicks the face
a standard context menu appears
a radial shortcut menu appears near the pointer
the radial menu includes "Extrude", "Select Other...", "Select Tangencies", and "New Sketch"
the standard menu includes "Properties" and "Export Face As..."

scenarios.name: Clear an entity selection from empty viewport space

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software is in the part modeling workspace
no command or modal dialog is active

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with a solid face selected
the user left-clicks empty viewport space
the entity returns to its neutral appearance
the contextual selection cue closes

scenarios.name: Pick a sketch point in the 3D viewport

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software is in the part modeling workspace
no command or modal dialog is active

scenario_steps.name: a visible 3D sketch point is exposed in the viewport
the user clicks near the point
the pick cue identifies "1. Point (3D Sketch6)"

scenarios.name: Open sketch-curve context menus during a 3D sketch

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software is in the part modeling workspace
no command or modal dialog is active

scenario_steps.name: a 3D sketch is active and a visible sketch segment is exposed
the user right-clicks the segment
a radial shortcut menu appears near the pointer
the radial menu includes "Create 3D Line", "Bend", "Three Point Arc", "Helical Curve", "General Dimension", and "Finish 3D Sketch"
a standard context menu includes "Repeat Construction", "Edit 3D Sketch", "Properties...", "Measure", and "Export Object"
the user presses Escape
both context menus close
